annotations.title: List published plans, newest first: who approved each (a person or an agent), whether it ran and was checked, the agent's self-review, its own call on running the plan without approval, and auto_run: what the channel's auto-run setting did or would do with it (outcome ran/would_run/would_wait, the deciding reason, channel, on/off, confidence bar and any saved auto-run decision), and runs_as: code when approved work runs, or ran, without an agent (a plan that only resolves the case, or sends one reply and then resolves it), otherwise agent

description: List published plans, newest first: who approved each (a person or an agent), whether it ran and was checked, the agent's self-review, its own call on running the plan without approval, and auto_run: what the channel's auto-run setting did or would do with it (outcome ran/would_run/would_wait, the deciding reason, channel, on/off, confidence bar and any saved auto-run decision), and runs_as: code when approved work runs, or ran, without an agent (a plan that only resolves the case, or sends one reply and then resolves it), otherwise agent. Includes totals comparing the agent's calls with people's decisions. Read-only.

approver.description: agent: approved through a person's delegated API, CLI or MCP connection. auto_run: approved by a channel's auto-run setting

call.description: The agent's own call on running the plan without approval, judged against the company's autonomy rubric

show.description: executed (default): plans whose approved work was sent to run; all: every published plan
